lines.x: Heheh, aren't you the lucky one, Doctor? I don't have any work for the day, so I wouldn't mind keeping you company for a bit.
The marketplaces of Lungmen, the suburbs of Ursus, the ancient ruins of Victoria... Doctor, these lands hold countless beautiful sights, but very few people ever slow down and take them all in.
Doctor, do you want to hear a story from my travels? In that case, I think we should get some fine tea cakes before we sit down. Otherwise, even the most captivating story will turn boring.

I've watched plenty of organizations rise and fall, but so far, Rhodes Island is the most interesting one I've seen. Will the epochs bend to your will, or finally swallow you whole...? I'm dying to find out.
Doctor, I have a few ideas where we can get some good food at our next destination. Interested?

Doctor, you seem to already know a thing or two about fallen angels. Unfortunately, I can't give you any more details than what you've got. Even if I shared everything else with you someday, that would stay my one secret.

Doctor, you don't need to worry about maintaining a good relationship with me. Friends, family, and love... I've got nothing against them, but I don't need them either. Heh, not like that's going to stop you from trying, right? Well, I don't really mind, so give it your best shot.

Hey, Doctor, I'm back from... Whoa, were you waiting for me here? You even prepared a whole table of snacks... Hehe, all right. How could I turn you down after a gesture like that? In return, I'll tell you about the fun I had on this last delivery run.
...I see now. The spark of joy I felt when I thought of having a friend like you wasn't fake after all. Scrap what I said before, Doctor. Maybe I do need a bit of warmth in my life.
Hehe... Sweet dreams, Doctor.

Hey there, Doctor. I'm Mostima. You might've heard from Emperor that I'm not bound by the contract between Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, and can therefore act independently. Having that said, I'll probably be staying here anyway when I'm not busy. Sooo, I'll see you around.
Well then, let's see how Rhodes Island fights.
You know, Doctor, relying on me isn't a very wise decision.
You really want to see me go all out, Doctor? Just for the record, I have to ask… Do I have to pay for the collateral damage I cause? No, right?
OK.
Hmm... Sorry, but why don't we let everyone do their own thing?
Ah. I know this place. Let me lead the way.
Get in, get out.
Uh-huh?
Heh heh…
Nice weather today.
Great view from here.
Seventy percent-ish should do the trick.
It's about time to wrap things up.
I have nothing against you guys. It's just the story of our lives.
I wonder what we should eat after this?
Feels good. Guess I could use a thrill every now and then.
Hm? I thought I missed a few, but I guess that's a job well done.
The results of a battle don't really matter to a Messenger. Just surviving is enough of a victory.
Gotta admit, this 'teamwork' isn't really my thing.
Mind if I go wander around?
Oh?
Let's have a chat, Doctor.
Arknights.

This day used to be like any other for me. Wouldn't stop long at any one place, wouldn't form any serious friendships, wouldn't have fun like everyone else. I never imagined I'd enjoy the holiday atmosphere here. I gotta admit, it isn't half bad. Happy New Year, Doctor, hope we all enjoy it.
How's your day going, Doctor?

So today's your birthday, Doctor. Happy birthday. Would you take an incredible story from my travels as a present? I guess not... alright, how about we take a trip together? I'll pick the scenery, you choose the time.

The more dangerous the place, the more enchanting the views get. Once you make it through every layer of danger, to finally stand in the eye of a Catastrophe, you're a part of the scenery yourself. In the end, where will you lead Rhodes Island, Doctor? I'm still dying to see.
